work.title: Readela 0.3.0: a controlled memory and processor baseline of the unchanged fourth-correction code, before further corrections
work.ownerAuthorization: Owner instruction of 2026-10-12 for the first step of ENT-246 under DEC-144: correct the existing measuring script and its page only where a comparison would otherwise be unsound, run the cases one after another in fresh isolated browser profiles on an otherwise quiet machine, and report. It names no product change, no change to Personal OS, no merge, tag, publication or store submission, and asks that pull request 9 stay a draft. It does not name a push; none is made under this record without the owner's word.

parentPreflight.reason: That record covers the fourth correction through its evidence and is not edited. It was assessed before DEC-144 and before the independent audit of 2026-10-12, and names the measuring script as it then was. This step is a separately bounded piece of work, so it carries its own assertion.

inScope: This record, committed first on the existing branch from baseCommit.

test/perf/run.mjs and test/perf/fixtures/page.html: a case without the extension that does in the page what the measuring script does there for a bookmark and a return; a fixed number of cycles at a fixed pace; a boundary after which the fonts are loaded and the page is warm; samples of the browser's processes that force no collection; memory dumps checked for validity and kept whole; the browser, build, script and page identities written into each result.

Measurements of the code of baseCommit, built unchanged, one case at a time: without the extension, with Readela and the site's own typography, with Readela and Readela Sans, under one theme; a block of work, about five minutes left alone, the same block again.
Dated evidence under docs/evidence/ and the measurement files outside the repository.
outOfScope: Any file under src/, the manifests, the build and packaging scripts, the unit and end-to-end suites, dependencies.

The corrections the audit and the owner's review ask for: the colour-scheme callback, ownership of site-owned parts, the first painted frame, the bookmark write authority, the wrong-target return, Auto direction.
A change of fonts or typography, a new measuring framework, a new dependency.
The owner's browser profile, a signed-in site, a real conversation, any network request by the measured page.
Merging pull request 9, marking it ready, a tag, a release, a store submission, store images and copy (ENT-243, paused), any write to Personal OS.
Capabilities, Exceptions, the dev-standards pin and the repository ruleset.
